newsitem.title: USA: U.S. envoy postpones Mideast trip due to bombing.
newsitem.headline: U.S. envoy postpones Mideast trip due to bombing.

text.p: President Bill Clinton's special Middle East envoy Dennis Ross on Wednesday postponed a trip to the region because of the Jerusalem bombing attack.
"The trip will be postponed. The Israelis are mourning their people. We'll postpone it until it is appropriate," White House spokesman Anne Luzzatto told reporters.

Ross was to have left for the Middle East on Wednesday evening to deliver some U.S. ideas for reinvigorating the negotiations between Israel and the Palestinians. Luzzatto said he would delay his departure until the Israelis decide "it's appropriate to make the trip."
Luzzatto also said Clinton planned to call Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to express U.S. condolences on the Israeli attack, which killed 13 people and injured scores of others.
